items.name: Boarding pass
items.note: Paper with thermal print — fine in the paper bin, the ink volume is negligible.

items.name: Shipping label (DHL)
items.note: Adhesive labels are OK. Peeled off or still on the box — both go in blue.

items.name: Cardboard box
items.note: Flatten it first. Tape and labels can stay on.

items.name: Newspaper / magazine
items.note: Clean and dry only.

items.name: Envelope
items.note: Plastic windows are fine — they're filtered out at the mill.

items.name: Egg carton (clean)
items.note: Clean pulp carton → blue. If soiled with egg, use green.

items.name: Instruction leaflet
items.note: Plain printed paper.

items.name: Pizza box lid (clean)
items.note: Tear off the clean lid for blue; the greasy base goes in green.

items.name: Fruit & vegetable peel
items.note: Classic organic waste.

items.name: Coffee grounds & filter
items.note: Grounds and paper filter both go in.

items.name: Tea bag
items.note: Remove metal staples and plastic-mesh bags (those go in black).

items.name: Eggshells
items.note: Fine in the organic bin.

items.name: Leftover food / bread
items.note: Cooked and raw food scraps both allowed.

items.name: Kitchen roll / napkin (used)
items.note: Wet or greasy paper belongs in green, not blue.

items.name: Cut flowers & plants
items.note: No soil-filled pots.

items.name: Paper bio-bag
items.note: ✅ Approved in Erlangen. Toss the whole bag in, banderole included.

items.name: Aluminium foil (with food residue)
items.note: Scrape the big bits into green, then the foil goes in yellow. No rinsing needed.

items.name: Seasoning / sauce sachet
items.note: Shiny laminate = plastic+foil composite. Still packaging → yellow.

items.name: Chilli paste pouch (dirty)
items.note: "Löffelrein" (spoon-clean) is enough — don't waste water washing it.

items.name: Bubble wrap
items.note: Polyethylene packaging. Squash it flat; no need to pop the bubbles.

items.name: Burger / meat tray (paper-look)
items.note: Molded paper fibre with a plastic laminate = composite → yellow, NOT blue.

items.name: Yoghurt pot
items.note: Separate the lid from the pot so both get sorted correctly.

items.name: Tin / can
items.note: Metal packaging → yellow.

items.name: Milk or juice carton
items.note: Composite beverage carton → yellow.

items.name: Medicine blister pack
items.note: Empty blisters only.

items.name: Shampoo bottle
items.note: Empty plastic packaging.

items.name: Onion net + tag
items.note: Fruit/veg nets are packaging.

items.name: Plastic film / cling wrap
items.note: Packaging film → yellow.

items.name: Dish sponge (used)
items.note: Synthetic foam and fibres — not recyclable, not packaging.

items.name: Meat soak pad
items.note: Contaminated composite from under the meat — always residual waste.

items.name: Fabric care label
items.note: Synthetic woven/coated label, neither paper nor packaging.

items.name: "Compostable" bioplastic bag
items.note: ❌ Banned from Erlangen's Biotonne. Empty contents into green, bag into black.

items.name: Supermarket receipt
items.note: Thermal paper is coated — keep it out of the paper bin.

items.name: Drinking glass
items.note: Different melting point than bottle glass — never in the glass container.

items.name: Ceramics / porcelain
items.note: Residual waste, not glass.

items.name: Nappies / hygiene items
items.note: Always residual waste.

items.name: Mop head / vacuum bag
items.note: Residual waste.

items.name: Old sock / worn textile
items.note: Worn-out textiles → black. Wearable clothes → Altkleidercontainer.

items.name: Toothbrush
items.note: Plastic object, not packaging.

items.name: Cigarette butts
items.note: Residual waste — never in the organic bin.

items.name: Old light bulb (non-LED)
items.note: Classic filament/halogen bulbs → black. LED and energy-saving → hazard.

items.name: Wood offcut (small)
items.note: Small untreated offcuts → black. Larger amounts → Wertstoffhof.

items.name: Wine / beer bottle
items.note: Sort by colour. Lids off → yellow bin.

items.name: Jam jar
items.note: Rinse lightly, metal lid into the yellow bin.

items.name: Perfume bottle
items.note: Clear glass → white container.

items.name: Batteries
items.note: Free collection boxes in every supermarket.

items.name: LED or energy-saving lamp
items.note: Contains electronics/mercury — drop-off point only.

items.name: Paint / solvent / glue
items.note: Liquid → hazard. Fully dried paint → black bin.

items.name: Spray can (full)
items.note: Pressurised/full → hazard. Completely empty → yellow.

items.name: Drain or oven cleaner
items.note: Aggressive chemicals → drop-off.

items.name: Waste oil / thermometer
items.note: Hazardous — never in any household bin.
